verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical and share the same faults. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow sits below the headline, which breaks the reading order, and it is too small to read. The orange divider has drifted under the legal text. The legal text is almost as large as the body copy, which flattens the hierarchy. The logo has shrunk to a speck. B is worse because its headline breaks into four lines with 'Our' stranded alone on the first, and 'Small-Batch' runs almost to both edges. A wraps the headline into a cleaner three lines.
